description: This file contains an extension of `OnboardingView`, providing various SwiftUI view builder methods that define multiple onboarding pages and helper UI components for the OpenClaw macOS application. It handles user onboarding flows such as welcoming, connection setup, permissions, CLI installation, workspace setup, chat interface, and completion step, utilizing external modules like AppKit, SwiftUI, and internal OpenClaw modules.

methods.name: pageView(for:)
methods.description: Returns the appropriate onboarding page view based on the given page index.

methods.name: welcomePage()
methods.description: Constructs the welcome onboarding page with security notices.

methods.name: connectionPage()
methods.description: Builds the connection setup page allowing selection of gateway options.

methods.name: permissionsPage()
methods.description: Creates the permissions grant page for macOS permissions.

methods.name: cliPage()
methods.description: Provides instructions for installing the CLI and related actions.

methods.name: workspacePage()
methods.description: Builds the agent workspace configuration page.

methods.name: onboardingChatPage()
methods.description: Displays a chat interface for onboarding the user agent.

methods.name: readyPage()
methods.description: Represents the final onboarding step with feature tips and status.
